attributes.action: Restrict loud private fireworks in residential areas during Diwali
attributes.additional_details: In my part of Newham, fireworks have gone off over three days during Diwali. At 9 pm, repeated bangs kept my children awake, and my dog was too frightened to go outside. Sudden bangs can wake and frighten young children, distress older residents, and cause cats and dogs to hide or tremble. Limiting loud fireworks to one advertised evening ending by 8 pm would give families and pet owners time to prepare and help protect children’s bedtimes.
attributes.background: Limit loud fireworks in residential areas during Diwali in England and Wales to organised displays ending by 11 pm. At 9 pm in Newham, repeated bangs kept my children awake and my dog was too frightened to go outside. The noise can also distress older residents and frighten cats.

rejection.details:
We have two petitions that have opened very recently which call for what your petition is generally seeking. You may wish to sign them.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
